seed: The menu bar's Control Shift D row is one row that toggles, the way Premiere's Link and Unlink are one row (task detached-sound-can-be-put-back-into-its-picture), at Next defaults with no flag touched. On the sample recording with its sound linked it reads Detach Audio and takes the sound off; with the loose sound picked it reads Re-attach Audio and puts it back, in step. It needs the probe in front, because a menu bar only reads live for the app that has focus.

steps.comment: The clip on V1 in the 1728x990 probe window, clicked the way a hand clicks it.

steps.note: The Clip menu's Detach Audio (Control Shift D) on the linked clip, and the sound is now its own clip on Audio, picked
THE TEST: the same row on the same key now read Re-attach Audio, and the sound is back inside its picture
With the picture picked after the join, the row reads Detach Audio again
